summary: Verified critical bug fix: felipejaramillo605@gmail.com now returns role=owner and access_status=approved via /api/auth/me. All owner cross-org permissions work as expected (services, appointments, organizations across all orgs; can filter by organization_id param). Manager isolation confirmed: manager without org gets 400, manager with org sees only own data even when passing other org_id in query. Frontend loads with 'Nexus by CS2' branding. API root also shows 'Nexus by CS2' branding. Google OAuth end-to-end login not testable in headless env, so simulated owner session via DB-injected session_token.
passed: API root returns 'Nexus by CS2 API - Barber Shop Management System'
GET /api/auth/me with owner session returns role=owner, access_status=approved for felipejaramillo605@gmail.com
GET /api/organizations as owner returns all organizations (no filter)
GET /api/services?organization_id=org_demo001 as owner returns services of that specific org
GET /api/services as owner (no org param) returns services across all orgs
GET /api/appointments as owner (no org param) returns all appointments across orgs
GET /api/services as manager without organization_id assigned returns 400 'No organization assigned'
GET /api/services as manager with org_demo001 returns only org_demo001 services
Manager isolation: even passing organization_id=org_other in query, manager still sees only their own org data (backend correctly ignores the param for non-owners)
Frontend loads with 'Nexus by CS2' branding on login screen
No 'Cuenta Pendiente de Aprobación' shown to unauthenticated users (shows login instead)
